notes: Phase-0 repair batch after migrating the workflow from Linux to macOS. (1) makelog.classify_path now canonicalises the candidate path and both roots, fixing collect()/replay when make echoes a symlinked spelling (macOS /var -> /private/var) while the configured roots are realpath'd; 29 tool test failures resolved and two regression tests added. (2) Three translation-introduced full-width quote pairs replaced with ASCII double quotes to satisfy term rule TL11 (base files use ASCII quotes). (3) Manifest metadata repair: cumulative allowed_paths backfilled for 25 files that were registered in files[] but never allowed; cumulative files[] deduplicated (47 stale duplicate entries); translated+preserved<=segments_total invariant restored for barrier.c/dsm.c/ipc.c/ipci.c/procarray.c in cumulative and in batch-0113/batch-0113b. check_scope --incremental and check_scope (cumulative) are the gates; verify_c_comments stays comment-only for the three C files.
